name: ipconfig
title: Inspect Windows Network Configuration with ipconfig
summary: Displays TCP/IP configuration details for Windows network adapters.

examples.description: Displays a basic summary of active network adapters.
Displays detailed configuration, including DNS, DHCP, MAC address, and lease information.
Releases the current DHCP-assigned IPv4 address.
Requests a new IPv4 address from the DHCP server.
Clears the local DNS resolver cache.

permissions.notes: Viewing configuration does not usually require administrator access. Some repair operations may require an elevated Command Prompt.

risk.warning: The release option temporarily removes the adapter's DHCP address and may interrupt network access until the address is renewed.

output_fields.name: IPv4 Address
output_fields.description: The current IPv4 address assigned to the network adapter.

output_fields.name: Subnet Mask
output_fields.description: Identifies which portion of the address represents the local network.

output_fields.name: Default Gateway
output_fields.description: The router or device used to reach other networks.

output_fields.name: DNS Servers
output_fields.description: The servers used to translate hostnames into IP addresses.

output_fields.name: DHCP Enabled
output_fields.description: Shows whether the adapter receives its configuration automatically from DHCP.

output_fields.name: Physical Address
output_fields.description: The MAC address assigned to the network adapter.

common_errors.meaning: The adapter does not currently have an active network connection.
The selected option may require an elevated Command Prompt.
